initial_plan.can_answer: yes: the data records annual motorist and cyclist death counts, allowing a direct comparison of the recorded counts
initial_plan.metric: Annual total number of people killed in crashes, shown separately for motorists and cyclists; for each group, sum its corresponding crash-level killed count
initial_plan.population: People recorded as motorists or cyclists killed in police-reported NYC motor vehicle crashes whose crash_date falls from 2013-01-01 through 2025-12-31, represented by summing crash-level counts
initial_plan.filters: crash_date in calendar years 2013 through 2025; no borough or location filter
initial_plan.years: Calendar years derived from crash_date, 2013-2025 inclusive
initial_plan.grouping: Calendar year and road-user group (motorist, cyclist)

data_check.crash_date: 0 missing and 0 known sentinel dates (1900-01-01, 1970-01-01, 0001-01-01) among eligible rows; DATE type cannot represent invalid calendar dates; each year 2013-2025 has observed dates from January 1 through December 31
data_check.decision: Keep all eligible rows. No rows within the planned dates are dropped or counted differently due to missing/default filter/group values or missing summed death counts; all 13 requested years have full observed calendar coverage. The population remains police-reported NYC motor vehicle crashes, not all deaths from all causes or a population/exposure-adjusted measure.

final_plan.can_answer: yes: compare the recorded annual totals of motorist and cyclist deaths directly
final_plan.metric: For each calendar year, the total number of motorist deaths and the total number of cyclist deaths, calculated by summing number_of_motorist_killed and number_of_cyclist_killed respectively across eligible crashes
final_plan.population: People recorded as motorists or cyclists killed in police-reported NYC motor vehicle crashes with crash_date in 2013-2025; all eligible crash rows retained
final_plan.filters: crash_date >= 2013-01-01 and < 2026-01-01; no borough or other location filter
final_plan.years: Complete calendar years 2013 through 2025, derived from crash_date
final_plan.grouping: Calendar year, with separate series for motorist and cyclist
final_plan.limitations: The data check found 2,132,218 eligible crash rows, all years 2013-2025 observed from January 1 to December 31, 0 missing crash dates within the selected population, and 0 missing values in either killed-count column. Counts describe deaths recorded in police-reported NYC motor vehicle crashes and are not exposure-adjusted; crashes with missing crash_date cannot be assigned to a requested year and fall outside the date filter.
